summary.text: Efstathia Booras is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Hillsborough 8 and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business executive, she previously served in the House for Hillsborough 33.

paragraphs.text: Efstathia Booras earned a B.A. from Notre Dame College.
Her career experience includes working as president and CEO of Alpha Mortgage and Financial Services, Inc.
Booras served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Hillsborough 33 from 2012 to 2016, and Ballotpedia lists her as assuming her current seat on December 7, 2022.

Ballotpedia lists her committee assignments as the Executive Departments and Administration Committee in 2013-2014 and the State-Federal Relations and Veterans Affairs Committee in later sessions, including 2023-2024.
